newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 index ends weaker but off lows.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 index ends weaker but off lows.

text.p: 1435 GMT - Bel-20 index of leading shares ends slightly weaker despite strong Wall Street, after recovering from lows in late trade.
* H1 1997 earnings release by Bel-20 heavyweights UCB, after close Wednesday, and Solvay and PetroFina Thursday weigh on market.
* Bel-20 index ends 3.41 points, or 0.13 percent, lower at 2,596.36 in 2,591.41/2,614.61 range
* Solvay notable loser, down 1.8 pct at 23,450.
